subject: Multiregion marketplace showcase — CloudForge + AWS (scheduling)
messages:
From: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@cloudforge.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: aws-partner-events@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Joint marketplace showcase — interested in a demo window

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking the introduction last week with our account team. CloudForge is excited to demonstrate our AWS-integrated data connector and managed deployment flow alongside Redwood’s Dedicated offering. AWS partner marketing has offered a co-marketing slot in the US West region the week of July 27, and we wanted to see if Redwood can commit to a 45-minute joint showcase (architectural + product demo + Q&A).

High-level asks:
- 45 minutes, audience: presales + cloud ops (~12 engineers/handlers)
- Live demo of multi-region failover + private deployment workflow
- Short runbook for post-demo follow-ups (pricing, next steps)

Proposed times (US/PDT):
- Tue Jul 28, 9:00–9:45am
- Wed Jul 29, 11:00–11:45am
- Thu Jul 30, 2:00–2:45pm

If you can share a preferred slot and who from Redwood will lead each segment (platform overview vs infra deep-dive), we’ll lock the AWS calendar and share the GoToMeet link.

Thanks — looking forward to pairing.

Best,
Rajesh
Sr. Partnerships Manager | CloudForge
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: Rajesh Kumar <rajesh@cloudforge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, aws-partner-events@amazon.com
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace showcase — interested in a demo window

Rajesh — thanks, this looks great. We can absolutely join and prefer a slot in the US West-friendly morning window. Tentative Redwood plan:
- Kimberly Park: product overview + marketplace positioning (15m)
- Karthik Iyer: infra/technical deep-dive and failover demo (20m)
- Quick Q&A and next steps (10m) — Marissa to capture follow-ups and action items.

From Redwood’s side we can do Tue Jul 28, 9:00–9:45am PDT. Vanessa — can you confirm AWS facilitator availability and whether we should request the AWS joint account manager be on the invite? Marissa — can you assemble a short runbook and an agenda to circulate?

I’ll provision a placeholder calendar invite once we confirm facilitator. For attachments, please send any partner collateral we should reference in the demo.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Joint marketplace showcase — interested in a demo window

Sounds good — I can lead the infra demo. Quick notes:
- For the failover portion I need test creds and a small demo dataset that matches CloudForge’s schema (approx 2–3GB). Rajesh, can CloudForge provision a read-only s3 bucket and a short Terraform snippet for the managed connector?
- Sequence: cold-start (cold KV cache) -> attach connector -> trigger failover -> show routing to dedicated instance. Total run time ~12–15 minutes.
- Can we keep the live demo to 20 minutes max; I’ll prep a recorded fallback in case of throttling.

Also want to confirm: do we want the demo to include a brief slide on Redwood Optimize recommendations (sizing/quantization)? I can do a 3–4 slide summary if so.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
